aisettings.askAnyAiFeature: Ask, and any AI feature added later. While this is off, Archstats sends nothing to any model and Ask is hidden.
aisettings.butNoProviderReady: On, but no provider is ready yet. Turn one on below.
aisettings.name: Name
aisettings.onlyIfServerAsks: Only if the server asks for one
aisettings.keptSentOnlyNever: Kept in the {keychainName} and sent only to {value}. It is never shown again.
aisettings.askMayReadLines: Ask may read lines of code
aisettings.linesAskReadsAnswer: The lines Ask reads to answer are sent to {p}.
aisettings.askAnswersNamesMeasures: Ask answers from names, measures and structure; no line of code goes to {p}.
aisettings.questionNamesPathsMeasures: The question, and the names, paths, measures and structure it needs from the open snapshot, with any figures you bring along with ⌘J.
aisettings.linesCodeAskReads: The lines of code Ask reads to answer.
aisettings.apiKeysTheyStay: API keys (they stay in the {keychainName} and go only to their own provider), other snapshots, other workspaces.
aisettings.whereChatApiLives: Where its chat API lives: the part before {icon}. Plain http only on this machine or your own network.
aisettings.readKeySavedHere: Read from {keySource}. A key saved here takes its place.
aisettings.administratorCanHoldAi: An administrator can hold AI off with {span} or a policy file at {policyPath}.
